note: A request ChatGPT agent (OpenAI) sent to api.seatgeek.com on 2025-08-11, whose signature SeatGeek's engineers published when writing their verifier; with the directory that published the signing key. Every byte below is copied from the sources, never retyped from memory. GATE-8 (accept/gate8/gate8.test.mjs).

request.by: Ander Parra and Connor Laidlaw, SeatGeek engineering (the operator of api.seatgeek.com)
request.how: They verified "real ChatGPT Agent request data" against Cloudflare's web-bot-auth while building a Kong verifier, and published the request's Signature, Signature-Input and Signature-Agent, its signature base (@authority api.seatgeek.com, @method GET, @path /2/events) and its URL. Only those three fields were published; the query (client_id=123) is not signed. The post gives no arrival time, so receivedAt is the signature's created.
